name: agent-team-builder-web
description: Statiskt webblager (hub/builder/galleri/portal) för Agent Team Builder.

scripts.dev:cf: node build-dist.mjs && npx --yes wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx --yes wrangler d1 migrations apply agent-team-builder --local
scripts.db:migrate: npx --yes wrangler d1 migrations apply agent-team-builder --remote
scripts.deploy: node build-dist.mjs && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name agent-team-builder
